$comment: The fifteen demo cases of the investigations desk. The desk lists the newest case first, so the file is written last to first. Everything is invented: Thornmere Mutual Insurance, its claimants, its claims, its parties and its public notices. Every id, date, amount and sentence is what the invented insurer returns when it is started with the date 26 November 2026.

Indicators met: FI-6 Estimate close to the limit

The car left the road on a bend and rolled onto its side. A passer-by saw it happen.
THE AGENT'S TASK
The agent builds the case file: the parties on the claim, their earlier claims, the links between this claim and other claims and parties, and the public notices that name a person on the claim, each with its source. The investigator decides what a link or a notice means. Everything here is as the investigations system holds it. The agent reads the claim itself from the investigations system.
